title: Suicide Bunny The Ltd Queen Cake Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Suicide Bunny’s indulgent Queen Cake is a comforting blend of rich and creamy sponge cake, laced with vanilla with tantalising top notes of tangy pineapple. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vapes and sub-ohm tanks .
